# Initialization
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data /structures/melt/SiO2/melt.dat

# Define potential
pair_style tersoff
pair_coeff * * /potentials/TERSOFF/2007_SiO.tersoff Si O

# Neighbor settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Compute temperature
compute mytemp all temp

# Timestep
timestep 0.001

# Initial velocity at 5000 K
velocity all create 5000.0 12345 dist gaussian

# NPT ensemble for quenching
# Quenching from 5000 K to 1500 K at 3.5 K/ps
# Time needed: (5000 - 1500) / 3.5 = 1000 ps = 1000000 steps (with dt=0.001 ps)
fix npt_quench all npt temp 5000.0 1500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

# Thermo output
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press vol density pe ke etotal

# Run quenching simulation
run 1000000

# Write final structure
write_data final_structure.dat

# Print final density
print "Final density: $(density)"
"}</action_input>
